english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for creativity, especially when discussing fresh ideas or designs.
This is the all-purpose noun for inventive ideas and clever solutions.
Use this specifically for a person's or work's inventiveness and ability to develop new ideas.
Use this for the creative capacity or ingenuity behind an invention rather than the invented thing itself.
Use this when imagination means practical creativity or resourcefulness in producing ideas.
